reason: 该插件的核心用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 用户在界面左下角提供余额与消耗情况的可视化悬浮组件，主要功能是展示余额条、剩余 token 环和今日用量横条，并通过 dsh-cost-meter 提供的数据定期刷新，属于面向界面展示与状态监控的功能插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 左下角新增悬浮展示面板，以余额条、剩余 token 环和今日消耗横条的方式可视化展示账户余额与用量，并基于 dsh-cost-meter 数据定时更新。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a floating panel in DeepSeek Harness to visualize balance and usage via a balance bar, remaining-token ring, and today’s consumption bar, with periodic updates from dsh-cost-meter data.

capabilities: Renders account balance and usage metrics in a floating sidebar widget within DeepSeek Harness.
Reads cost and balance data from the dsh-cost-meter data channel and refreshes on a periodic timer.
Adapts display styling to the active theme and hides in constrained sidebar states to reduce UI impact.

reasons.code: README explicitly describes a "左下角悬浮窗" with "余额血条/估算剩余 token 环/今日消耗横条" to present balance and usage visuals.
README states data is sourced from dsh-cost-meter, including official balance API and llm/stream ledger-derived token/fee data.
Repository description identifies it as a DeepSeek Harness left-bottom balance/usage floating plugin.
